name: GitHub
description: Sign in with GitHub to connect your account. You control each permission in Fabric.
tokenHelp: Use a fine-grained personal access token limited to the repositories and permissions you choose. Fabric verifies the account before saving it.
limitations: Organizations can restrict which apps reach their private resources until an owner approves Fabric.

name: Notion
description: Sign in with Notion and pick the pages Fabric may use.
tokenHelp: Enter an integration token. Share selected pages with that integration in Notion; Fabric cannot access unshared pages.
limitations: Connection identity is the integration bot, not a claim of whole-workspace access.

name: Slack
description: Sign in with Slack to connect your account. You control each permission in Fabric.
tokenHelp: Use an authorized Slack bot/user OAuth token with only needed scopes. Private channels additionally require appropriate membership.
limitations: Identity and workspace are verified; API methods still enforce their own scopes and membership.

name: Google Calendar
description: Discover calendar actions and data from Google's live API description, then authorize your account.
limitations: Operator must configure a Google OAuth client first.
Refresh follows Google's expiry, revocation and testing-mode policies; indefinite connection is not promised.
Discovery describes the API, not the contents or permissions of your account. Unsupported operations remain visible as gaps.

name: Gmail
description: Discover mail actions, data types and required scopes from Google's live API description.
limitations: A configured Google OAuth client with Gmail API enabled is required for account access.
Provider consent and Fabric's operation permissions are separate. Discovery itself does not read your email.
Restricted Gmail scopes may require Google's verification for public distribution. Uncompiled operations are not executable.

name: X / Twitter
tagline: Posts through your selected browser session
description: Use a deliberately paired browser tab; no account session is imported automatically.
limitations: Direct API OAuth is not implemented in this release.
Browser pairing is not proof of account identity or permission to post. Each action requires a bounded grant.

name: Facebook
description: Use a deliberately paired browser tab for supported visible interactions.
limitations: Direct Graph API integration is not implemented in this release.
Browser access does not bypass platform restrictions, login, consent or action approval.

name: Local workspace
description: Read and write a dedicated Fabric workspace with independent readback.
limitations: Access is restricted to the product's dedicated workspace, not your whole computer.

name: This computer
tagline: System details, USB hardware, and tools
description: Read real system information, connected USB hardware and installed command-line tools.
limitations: Read-only inventory; this is not control of every connected device or permission to execute arbitrary commands.

name: Instagram
description: Connect a browser tab; inspect its page and approve individual interactions.
limitations: Browser session only. No Instagram API account grant or complete account access is implied.

name: Spotify
tagline: The web player in your browser
description: Connect the Spotify web player in your browser.
limitations: Browser session only. Spotify OAuth and background playback control are not implemented.
